fields.Name: T234 - Credentials Audit Filter and View Toggle
fields.Description: Changing the date range re-queries the server (loadData with a date filter) while Status/Operation filter over the audit-specific client-derived operation field, and the toggle swaps a bespoke timeline vs table renderer.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Credentials', then open the 'Audit Log' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. In the toolbar, use the view toggle to switch between Timeline and Table and confirm the layout changes. Open the Filters popover and change the Time range (e.g., Last 24 hours vs Last 30 days) — the log list should reload. Also set Status to 'Success' or 'Failed' and confirm the events narrow or a no-match empty state appears.

judgeValidationCriteria: The view toggle switches between Timeline and Table layouts
Changing the Time range reloads/updates the event list
A Status (or Operation) filter narrows the events OR shows a no-match empty state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
